explanation: Request is physically valid and required no correction. Grid: W in {1.55, 1.65, 1.75} GeV x Q2 in {0.5, 1.0, 1.5} GeV^2 (9 points), all at cos(theta*)=0 and phi*=90 deg. The full W range lies above the eta-production threshold W_thr = m_p + m_eta = 0.938272 + 0.54786 = 1.486 GeV (hardcoded in exclurad.F), and Q2 in [0.5,1.5] GeV^2 falls well within the EtaMAID-2023 table coverage (Q2 = 0-5 GeV^2, W = 1.4856-6 GeV per mpintp.inc). Since only 9 points are needed, they fit in a single input file within the 10-point Fortran reader limit, so no chunking via rcgrid_inputgen.py was required. Used eta-channel defaults from README/examples: model=3 (EtaMAID/maid2000), ivec=1 (recoil proton), bmom=6.53 GeV (CLAS12), vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (CLAS12 eta analysis cut), rc_mode=0 (full O(alpha) correction), lepton=1 (electron).
